chain: control -> command -> owning service -> permission/FileSafe/route validation -> durable state -> event/receipt -> projection -> Usage/diagnostics -> retry
note: Every offline-capable command names its idempotency key. A command with no key is not offline-capable and says so by omission.

rows.permission_or_filesafe: Account entitlement check; no FileSafe involvement
rows.event_or_receipt: Route changed receipt; a boundary crossing also emits a decision record
rows.projection: Collapsed selector label, and requested to effective when they differ
rows.usage_or_diagnostics: Usage attributes the turn to the new account
rows.retry: Not retried; a failed switch leaves the previous route in force

rows.permission_or_filesafe: Adapter capability check; absent axis means the control is absent
rows.projection: Collapsed selector label
rows.usage_or_diagnostics: Usage records effort per turn
rows.retry: Not retried

rows.command: cmd.chat.effort sibling on the same axis set
rows.permission_or_filesafe: Adapter Fast-tier flag
rows.projection: Collapsed selector label
rows.usage_or_diagnostics: Usage records the tier
rows.retry: Not retried

rows.permission_or_filesafe: Mode ceiling narrows the profile; FileSafe governs each edit at execution time
rows.projection: Access footer and composer reason line
rows.usage_or_diagnostics: Diagnostics record the effective profile per action
rows.retry: Not retried

rows.permission_or_filesafe: Read-only by construction: no write path into runtime.access
rows.projection: Per-thread advice surface and the selector visual state
rows.usage_or_diagnostics: Not attributed to Usage; advice is not a turn
rows.retry: Not retried; unavailable never blocks the primary turn

rows.permission_or_filesafe: No FileSafe path; admission is prompt shaping
rows.event_or_receipt: Compaction receipt with before, after and preserved ancestry
rows.projection: Context ring popup pressure bar and receipt line
rows.usage_or_diagnostics: Usage is NOT rewritten; compaction changes what is admitted, not what happened
rows.retry: Retry is a new operation with a new id

rows.permission_or_filesafe: None
rows.projection: Context ring Included list
rows.usage_or_diagnostics: Usage unchanged
rows.retry: Not retried

rows.control: Prior chats, Add passage to context
rows.permission_or_filesafe: Source thread read permission
rows.projection: Included list, prior thread excerpt row
rows.usage_or_diagnostics: Usage counts the added tokens on the next turn
rows.retry: Not retried

rows.permission_or_filesafe: None
rows.projection: History and rewind affordances
rows.usage_or_diagnostics: Not a turn
rows.retry: Idempotent by key

rows.permission_or_filesafe: None
rows.durable_state: view[thread].threadOps.rewoundTo, plus a restore point created first
rows.event_or_receipt: Rewind receipt naming the restore point
rows.projection: Lineage marker in the transcript
rows.usage_or_diagnostics: Usage keeps the original turns
rows.retry: Not retried; a rewind is always undoable through its restore point

rows.permission_or_filesafe: None
rows.event_or_receipt: Branch record with branchedFrom and inheritedRefs
rows.projection: Lineage marker; the new thread appears in history
rows.usage_or_diagnostics: Usage attributes future turns to the new thread
rows.retry: Refusal is typed, never a silent drop

rows.control: More options, Send request to another thread
rows.permission_or_filesafe: Target thread read scope; budget bounds turns and seconds
rows.event_or_receipt: Request record; refused_cycle and refused_fanout are outcomes, not errors
rows.projection: Awaiting row in the work cluster
rows.usage_or_diagnostics: Usage attributes the target thread work to the target
rows.retry: Retry creates a new request id

rows.permission_or_filesafe: Unchanged from an online send
rows.durable_state: session.sync.outbox entry, and session.sync.replayed on replay
rows.event_or_receipt: Queued chip carrying the entry id; replay receipt names sent and skipped counts
rows.projection: Queued chip, then the ordinary transcript row
rows.usage_or_diagnostics: Usage attributes on actual send, not on enqueue
rows.retry: Replay marks the entry BEFORE dispatch, so a second reconnect sends nothing
rows.idempotency_key: outbox entry id (the entry id IS the idempotency key)

rows.permission_or_filesafe: None
rows.projection: Chip disappears
rows.usage_or_diagnostics: No Usage effect; nothing was sent
rows.retry: A sent entry cannot be withdrawn and the call refuses

rows.permission_or_filesafe: None
rows.event_or_receipt: Replay receipt; snapshot record while live events buffer
rows.projection: Sync chip and popup
rows.usage_or_diagnostics: Usage attributes each replayed send once
rows.retry: Idempotent by construction

rows.permission_or_filesafe: FileSafe governs reading the file; the resolver never reads outside the picked file
rows.event_or_receipt: Resolution record with class, representation and lineage
rows.projection: Composer chip showing the representation, not the file name alone
rows.usage_or_diagnostics: Usage counts the representation tokens
rows.retry: Re-resolution on model change returns changed ids

rows.permission_or_filesafe: Privacy and hosting change requires an explicit decision
rows.projection: Decision card; then the routed representation
rows.usage_or_diagnostics: Usage attributes to the alternate account
rows.retry: Cancel leaves the original resolution untouched

rows.permission_or_filesafe: None
rows.event_or_receipt: Receipt carrying answers and the skipped list
rows.projection: Durable receipt row in the transcript
rows.usage_or_diagnostics: Usage counts the answering turn
rows.retry: Not retried; the receipt is the record

rows.permission_or_filesafe: None
rows.projection: Questions cancelled receipt row
rows.usage_or_diagnostics: No Usage effect
rows.retry: Not retried

rows.control: Environment popup, Request a new worktree
rows.permission_or_filesafe: Worktree lease check; never removes another owner lease
rows.durable_state: Worktree Manager state, projected read-only into Chat
rows.projection: Environment popup worktree group
rows.usage_or_diagnostics: Diagnostics record the lease
rows.retry: Retry is a new request

rows.permission_or_filesafe: Port ownership check; a conflict resolution never mutates another owner state
rows.projection: Conflict card disappears from the decision surface
rows.usage_or_diagnostics: Diagnostics record the port change
rows.retry: Not retried

rows.permission_or_filesafe: Capacity check through RuntimeResourceGovernor; a required role queues rather than dropping
rows.event_or_receipt: Crew record with members, waves and a reducer
rows.projection: Crew board artifact
rows.usage_or_diagnostics: Usage attributes each member route separately
rows.retry: Stop is explicit; a wave never restarts itself

rows.permission_or_filesafe: Artifact read permission
rows.projection: The window artifact frame
rows.usage_or_diagnostics: No Usage effect; opening is not a turn
rows.retry: Retry re-enters loading through the same state machine

rows.permission_or_filesafe: Destination mapping owned by the Notifications owner
rows.projection: Title-bar stack and inbox only
rows.usage_or_diagnostics: Diagnostics record delivery
rows.retry: Delivery retry is the owner concern, not Chat
